node.statement: For gamma=((a_r,b_r))_{r=1}^m and sigma in {+1,-1}^m, set W_{gamma,sigma}=direct-sum_r sigma_r U^{(r)}_{a_r b_r} and q_{gamma,sigma}=2^(-m) product_r d_r^(-2). This is a finite family, every W_{gamma,sigma} is unitary, every q is positive, and the q's sum to 1.
